## Result

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or agreed scope.

## Verification

List the checks actually run and their results. Distinguish fixture tests, app observations and real-device evidence. Explain any check that could not be performed.

## Boundaries and limitations

Note relevant unavailable data, hardware/signing gates or behavior changes. Confirm any default tests remain free of hardware writes. For documentation-only changes, a brief link/content check is enough.

Before submitting, review the diff and attachments for private data. Keep databases, runtime logs, signing material and owner-specific evidence local.

## Integration readiness

Target `main` unless a different base is agreed. Keep the PR draft while required
checks, independent review or agreed native/device acceptance are pending.
State the review result, or why independent review is unnecessary for this scope.
Follow `CONTRIBUTING.md`; related refinements belong in this PR.
